Y80. / G43 Z15. H1 / G1 ...), the machine OFF; the page enters the simulation, the page's OWN entry track is read from its collision worker's side request (the Worker tapped and forwarded), the scrub put at the entry's end (cum[1], the slider's step grid set to 'any') and the SCENE read: the tool tip in the machine frame (__viewerDiag.getToolTip), the scrub pose, the bar's time. The toolsetter section was NOT pinned (_save_toolsetter refused the probe-tool key #3014: KeyError, a driver error) — both runs ran with the fresh copy's unset section, the same state; the bar's totals compare between the two runs only.
